lines: Summer: the first picture with all five mended parts together is drawn (final tier, main at 0e9dbcca) and laid beside the approved image. Bettered, not mended. At the size of a feed our seeds read as white stars on a dark ball, the base as even grey, the heap of sand as a dark wedge, the net of light on the table as a white bolt, and the storm as an even cream fog.

A new ruler reads the same fifteen regions from the approved image and from ours. It corrected my eye three times: the approved base is not paler than ours but darker in the middle and sunlit at its edges; the approved ball is not clearer but brighter and warm; the approved storm is not whiter but has dark between fine streaks.

The five summer builders started on a second list at 11:57 with those numbers and pictures, limit 12:37. Then one merged picture again, then Round 21, where the critics see summer; it has two of its three rounds left.

In main since the last status: the app's sound half a decibel lower, with the new music entering on a bar line after a landing; the live particles keep their worker through a page that stands still (open item 234); the masters' tool reads every frame for values that are no number and refuses a chunk that has one. Whole test run on a clean tree before these three: 721 passed, none failed.

Open: the sound check's test of the Sound control came back open twice and passed twice on one source (open item 236); its cause is being measured, so the sound check is not a pass now. The published app is still the build of 11:02.
phase 6: 9.16 h used of its 12.00 h box
allowance (after the review): 9.16 h used of 12.00 h allowed

pictures.caption: Summer at rest: the approved image (left) and ours at the final tier (right), main at 0e9dbcca with all five mended parts. Ours: white star shapes on a darker ball, a grey base, a dark heap of sand at the right, a white zigzag of light on the table.

Summer half a second after a landing: approved (left), ours at the final tier (right). Ours is an even cream fog of short thick strokes over the whole ball; the approved has finer streaks with dark between them, and a bright haze low down.

The inside at rest, large: approved (left), ours at the review tier (right). Our seeds are white asterisks, all alike; the approved seeds are soft tufts on thin stalks in a glowing ball. Our band of sand at the bottom of the glass is flat and tall.

The base and the table: approved (left), ours at the review tier (right). The approved stone is cream with sunlit patches and deep shade, level strata, pale frosted sea glass; ours is even grey with broad folds and saturated gems, and its net of light is a white bolt where the approved is fine gold thread.
